mislabeled_ground_truth.description: Ground truth label in original dataset was human-error mislabeled (e.g. image shows 00008, label was 00000). Model prediction was visually correct.

crop_truncation_right_edge.description: Physical bounding box was cut prematurely, missing the 5th or 6th trailing digit.

real_model_confusion.description: True digit confusion: half-turn transition numbers (e.g. rolling 8/9), extreme specular reflections/glare, or dark rust occlusions.
